//: Workflow catalog per SPEC §3 (USE-001..006). REPLACES the v2 per-ICP catalog, which had 30 bespoke funding-anchored descriptions with no shared vocabulary. Use cases now come from a fixed set of SIX alert families plus eleven MCP workflows; an ICP's assignment is a POOL and the selector returns at most three, at most one per family. Filters (industry, stage, size, geography, territory, funding amount, recency, selected investors) configure a family and never create one.
//deferred: ICP #9 is classified but selects NO use case until product and delivery context are known (USE-006).
//forbidden: launch_market_entry and fundraising_window are NOT catalog entries and are rejected at build time.

funded_icp_match.name: recently funded companies matching your filters
funded_icp_match.definition: Companies that have just raised, narrowed by sector, stage, size, current geography and any other ICP filter.
funded_icp_match.excludes: Territory and stage are FILTERS on this family, never families of their own.

geographic_expansion.name: companies entering a new geography
geographic_expansion.definition: Evidence that a company is opening an office or entering a market it was not in before.
geographic_expansion.excludes: Where a company already is does not qualify. Existing location is a filter on funded_icp_match.

investor_portfolio.name: companies tied to investors you care about
investor_portfolio.definition: Companies connected to a selected set of investors. Two distinct jobs: relationship_leverage uses a confirmed investor connection, peer_activity watches what other firms are doing.
investor_portfolio.excludes: Never promise a warm introduction. Kept separate from funded_icp_match because the job is the relationship, not the round.

hiring_growth.name: companies staffing up
hiring_growth.definition: Evidence of hiring, building out a function, or a material headcount increase.
hiring_growth.excludes: Hiring is the signal in its own right; it does not require a raise to qualify.

growth_momentum.name: non-funding growth milestones
growth_momentum.definition: Revenue, customer, partnership or operating milestones that show a company is compounding.
growth_momentum.excludes: Funding is NOT momentum here — a raise belongs to funded_icp_match.

enterprise_readiness.name: companies moving upmarket
enterprise_readiness.definition: Evidence of an enterprise, security or regulated-customer motion: SOC2, first enterprise logos, compliance hires.
enterprise_readiness.excludes: A large round alone is not readiness.

find_relevant_investors.name: find investors who actually back companies like yours
find_relevant_investors.example_prompt: Which seed funds led rounds in developer tools in the last 12 months?

research_investor_fit.name: check whether a fund is a real fit before you reach out
research_investor_fit.example_prompt: Has Renegade Partners invested in vertical SaaS, and at what stage?

build_investor_outreach.name: draft outreach grounded in a fund's actual portfolio
build_investor_outreach.example_prompt: Draft an intro to a16z referencing their last three fintech investments.

map_fundraising_market.name: map who is active in your market right now
map_fundraising_market.example_prompt: Who has funded seed-stage climate hardware in the past six months?

map_investment_thesis.name: turn your thesis into a live screen
map_investment_thesis.example_prompt: Show me B2B infrastructure companies raising Series B at $20M+ this quarter.

research_company_founder.name: research a founder's track record before a first call
research_company_founder.example_prompt: What has this founder built before, and who funded it?

identify_momentum.name: spot which portfolio or watchlist companies are compounding
identify_momentum.example_prompt: Which companies on my watchlist announced customer or partnership milestones this month?

unify_sourcing_context.name: pull everything you know about a company into one view
unify_sourcing_context.example_prompt: Give me the full picture on this company: rounds, investors, people, recent signals.

prepare_founder_outreach.name: prepare a first-call brief on a founder
prepare_founder_outreach.example_prompt: Brief me before my call with this founder: company, funding, team, recent news.

update_investment_crm.name: keep your CRM current without manual entry
update_investment_crm.example_prompt: Update my pipeline with the latest round and investor data for these ten companies.

monitor_thesis.name: get told when something matches your thesis
monitor_thesis.example_prompt: Alert me whenever a company matching my thesis raises.

Grounded drafts scale the part of the service that takes longest.
A live market map is what keeps client advice current.
A thesis you can query is a sourcing engine rather than a document.
Founder track record is the fastest disqualifier.
